_about: Settings for the Molili mod. Each setting has its description on the line above it. Keep the quotes and commas.
_DIARY_ORDER: asc = oldest first (the server's order). desc = newest first. Changes only the diary page.
_STREAM: true = chat replies appear word by word. false = each reply appears at once.
_DEBUG: true = verbose console output (use when reporting a problem).
_LMSTUDIO_URL: Address of LM Studio's chat server. LM Studio must be running there.
_LMSTUDIO_MODEL: Model name as shown in LM Studio. Empty = the model LM Studio has loaded.
_TEMPERATURE: How varied the replies are. 0 = very steady, 1 or more = more varied.
_MAX_TURNS: How many recent messages the model remembers.
_CDP_PORT: Debug port Molili's web view uses. Keep 9222: start-molili-local.bat opens this port.
_LOGIN_MODE: auto = real server when reachable, saved account when not. local = always the saved account, never overwritten from the server. cloud = server only. Not set here, so account.json's "loginMode" can be used; to set it here, add "LOGIN_MODE": "local".
_RECORD: true = save the server's answers to capture/ (needed for offline use). false = save nothing.
_CRAWL: auto = save the diary, store and balances once when the server answers. 1 = on every start. 0 = never.
_CRAWL_PAGE_SIZE: Diary entries requested per page when saving.
_GATEWAY: true = chat, history and account are handled locally. false = only chat and history.
_CLOUD_TIMEOUT_MS: Milliseconds to wait for the server before falling back to saved data.
_OFFLINE_STUB: true = while the server is down, answer unknown requests with an empty success instead of an error.
_LOCAL_BLOCK_NET: true = in local mode, refuse all internet requests from the game. false = allow them.
_DIARY: auto = write the daily diary in local mode. 1 = always. 0 = never.
_DIARY_BACKFILL: Days the diary may catch up on after the PC was off. 0 = today only.
_DIARY_DELAY_MS: Milliseconds to wait after startup before the diary is written.
_ACTIVE_MESSAGES: true = the character sends her own messages after you have been quiet (offline / server down). false = never. The level comes from the game's Active Message Frequency setting.
_ACTIVE_HOURS_NORMAL: Hours of silence before a message burst when the game's frequency is Normal.
_ACTIVE_HOURS_HIGHER: Hours of silence before a burst when the frequency is Higher.
_ACTIVE_HOURS_HIGH: Hours of silence before a burst when the frequency is High.
_ACTIVE_MAX_MESSAGES: Most messages in one burst (the game has no setting for this).
_PERSONA_FILE: Your character sheet. Copy persona.example.txt to persona.txt and edit it.
_HISTORY_FILE: Saved chat messages. Empty = not saved between runs.
_COMPANION_FILE: Saved state of the Accompany timer (companion.json), so a running task keeps its time.
_LEVELS_FILE: Record of the affinity each level needs (levels.json), filled in as the server reports it.
_FAVORITES_FILE: The collected messages (favorites.json), kept for offline use.
_CAPTURE_DIR: Folder for the saved server answers.
_SEED_FILE: Molili's store.json. If there is no account yet, its name and settings are imported. The login token is never copied.
_ALLOW_ORIGINS: Extra web page addresses allowed to call the local server, comma-separated. Normally empty.
